normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from public beach access- Complimentary beach setups at Walton Dunes Access each morning, includes 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Ultimate outdoor space: Huge private heated pool with a splash deck and spa—spa and pool heated together. **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**- Complimentary Peloton Bike - an Alaya exclusive amenity- Professional kitchen with dining for the entire crew- In-home elevator- Game room with pool table and air hockey table- 9 Adult Bikes- 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle - Event-friendly- Weights- Pickleball court- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience the beauty of Chivallionare, a stunning Gulf-view Main House and Guest House in the heart of Seagrove Beach! Accommodating 36 guests across 9 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms, this luxurious 4-story retreat spans 5,926 square feet with breathtaking Emerald Coast views. Large groups and families will love the expansive outdoor space and unbeatable location—steps from the beach!Designed for making memories, guests can unwind on the pool’s splash deck or sitting spa, surrounded by loungers. An outdoor kitchen with a beverage cooler and grill sets the stage for sunset patio dinners, while plush furniture invites relaxation. Keep the excitement alive in the first-floor game room featuring air hockey, a pool table, and a large sectional for movie nights. Late-night fun abounds in the 2 bunk rooms—each with 1 twin-over-twin bed, 2 queen-over-queen beds, and a private bathroom.In-home elevator doors open to the second-floor great room, showcasing elegant wood floors and glass French doors. Plan the day’s activities from 2 stylish sofas or matching armchairs in the living area. A wet bar with a wine chiller and ice maker enhances dinner at the 12-person dining table, while the 9-stool breakfast bar suits quick bites. Host a personal chef or cook together in the gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, then enjoy alfresco dining or relaxation on the off-kitchen balcony boasting a sectional. Retire to 2 guest bedrooms, one with a private bathroom, each with king beds and balconies.Relax in the third-floor primary bedroom featuring a king bed, private soaking tub, and a spacious private deck with ample seating and Gulf views. A bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 2 guest bedrooms with king beds—all with balcony access!A spiral staircase leads to the fourth-floor rooftop deck, offering unparalleled views. The theater room includes a 75” TV, sectional couch, and nearby wet bar—plus a Peloton!The Guest House features a kitchen, sitting area, queen sleeper sofa, balcony, private bedroom, bathroom, and a washer-dryer.With 6 parking spots, 9 bikes, and a low speed vehicle, Chivallionare makes exploring easy. Enjoy beach access via Chivas Lane’s private boardwalk or the Walton Dunes Public Beach on Beachfront Trail. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 36):FIRST FLOOR:- Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Game Room: Large Sectional for Movie NightsSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom- Bunk Room: Two Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Jack and Jill Bathroom- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa* Please

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove "Chivallionare" 138 Chivas Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 9 Beds 22 Sleeps 36 Full Baths 9 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from public beach access - Complimentary beach setups at Walton Dunes Access each morning, includes 4 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31) - Ultimate outdoor space: Huge private heated pool with a splash deck and spa—spa and pool heated together. **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day** - Complimentary Peloton Bike - an Alaya exclusive amenity - Professional kitchen with dining for the entire crew - In-home elevator - Game room with pool table and air hockey table - 9 Adult Bikes - 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle - Event-friendly - Weights - Pickleball court - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Experience the beauty of Chivallionare, a stunning Gulf-view Main House and Guest House in the heart of Seagrove Beach! Accommodating 36 guests across 9 bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms, this luxurious 4-story retreat spans 5,926 square feet with breathtaking Emerald Coast views. Large groups and families will love the expansive outdoor space and unbeatable location—steps from the beach! Designed for making memories, guests can unwind on the pool’s splash deck or sitting spa, surrounded by loungers. An outdoor kitchen with a beverage cooler and grill sets the stage for sunset patio dinners, while plush furniture invites relaxation. Keep the excitement alive in the first-floor game room featuring air hockey, a pool table, and a large sectional for movie nights. Late-night fun abounds in the 2 bunk rooms—each with 1 twin-over-twin bed, 2 queen-over-queen beds, and a private bathroom. In-home elevator doors open to the second-floor great room, showcasing elegant wood floors and glass French doors. Plan the day’s activities from 2 stylish sofas or matching armchairs in the living area. A wet bar with a wine chiller and ice maker enhances dinner at the 12-person dining table, while the 9-stool breakfast bar suits quick bites. Host a personal chef or cook together in the gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, then enjoy alfresco dining or relaxation on the off-kitchen balcony boasting a sectional. Retire to 2 guest bedrooms, one with a private bathroom, each with king beds and balconies. Relax in the third-floor primary bedroom featuring a king bed, private soaking tub, and a spacious private deck with ample seating and Gulf views. A bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 2 guest bedrooms with king beds—all with balcony access! A spiral staircase leads to the fourth-floor rooftop deck, offering unparalleled views. The theater room includes a 75” TV, sectional couch, and nearby wet bar—plus a Peloton! The Guest House features a kitchen, sitting area, queen sleeper sofa, balcony, private bedroom, bathroom, and a washer-dryer. With 6 parking spots, 9 bikes, and a low speed vehicle, Chivallionare makes exploring easy. Enjoy beach access via Chivas Lane’s private boardwalk or the Walton Dunes Public Beach on Beachfront Trail. Book now!
